inputs.title: Legal Contract Upload
inputs.description: Upload your contract PDF for AI analysis.

toolData.description: Start a workflow when a web form is submitted

path.description: The path URL slug for the form

formResponseRedirectUrl.description: URL to redirect to after submission

toolData.description: Upload a PDF file and make it directly available to the next node. No format conversion - just upload and pass along.
Extract text from documents and images using Mistral OCR.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Select the Mistral OCR model to use.

fields.name: url
fields.description: You can provide one URL or multiple URLs separated by commas or new lines.

fields.name: inputDataFieldName
fields.description: Binary field name. Use comma-separated fields (e.g., file1,file2) or * to process all binary fields.

options.name: Enable Batch Processing
options.description: Queue OCR requests for batch processing when supported by your workflow.

inputs.question:
You are an AI legal assistant.

Analyze the following contract.

{{Extract Text Document.text}}

Provide:

1. Executive Summary
2. Parties involved
3. Important dates
4. Key obligations
5. Potential legal risks
6. Missing or unusual clauses
7. Overall Risk Score (Low, Medium, High)

Return the answer in Markdown and give in pdf .

toolData.description: Execute prompts with various LLM models (Gemini, Groq)

systemPrompt.description: System prompt or persona that sets behavior (optional, hidden in UI)

requireSpecificOutputFormat.description: Whether to require a specific output format

outputFormatSchema.description: The schema or description of the required output format (e.g. JSON schema or "name, age, email")

enableFallback.description: Whether to auto-retry with a fallback model if the primary fails

fallbackModel.description: The fallback model ID to use when the primary model fails

temperature.description: Controls how random or creative the output is. Lower values produce more focused and deterministic responses, higher values produce more varied and creative output.

maxTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens (words/word-pieces) the model is allowed to generate in its response. Higher values allow longer answers but cost more.

topK.description: Limits the model to only consider the top K most probable next tokens at each step. Lower values make output more focused, higher values allow more variety.

apiKey.description: API key for the selected LLM provider

userId.description: ID of the user executing the workflow

toolData.description: Stores chat history in-memory (session-based). Local to the current execution environment.

fields.name: notice
fields.displayName: This node stores memory locally in the node instance. It is not compatible with Queue Mode setups as memory will not be shared across workers. For production use with scaling, consider using external memory.

fields.name: sessionId
fields.description: Where to get the session ID from. This is used to track history across interactions.

fields.name: sessionKey
fields.description: Provide a custom session key. Only used if Session ID is set to Manual.

fields.name: contextWindowLength
fields.description: How many past interactions (user + assistant pairs) the model receives as context.
